span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Sounds and vibrations that share frequency content co-occur constantly in everyday experience, and this long history of co-activation builds audio-tactile associations inside frequency-processing circuits
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Predictive coding: hearing a tone evokes the neural representation of the tactile event usually associated with that tone, producing parietal activity with no mechanical stimulation at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Auditory signals reach parietal cortex over already-documented cortico-cortical and thalamo-cortical routes linking the auditory and somatosensory systems
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: subgroups of voxels in classically defined somatosensory regions of the parietal lobe respond to audition and are better suited to represent auditory frequency information
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the proposed route being an extensive history of co-activation at frequencies common to both senses, so that hearing a tone evokes the tactile representation associated with it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the association may be feature-specific - frequency shared between the senses where stimulus duration appears to rely on modality-dedicated circuits
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: fMRI's temporal resolution cannot say whether the parietal auditory responses are feedforward or feedback.
span.note: what this limits: the direction of the parietal auditory signal: DUE TO THE LIMITED TEMPORAL RESOLUTION OF fMRI, Quotation withheld
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the task performed during the discrimination scans, designed to ensure that participants attended to stimulus frequency, did not permit a sensitive analysis of auditory discrimination performance
span.note: what this limits: the analysis the discrimination scans could not support: THE TASK ... DESIGNED TO ENSURE THAT PARTICIPANTS ATTENDED TO STIMULUS FREQUENCY, DID NOT PERMIT A SENSITIVE ANALYSIS

span.label: these observations need to be confirmed in ultra-high resolution scanning and single-unit recording experiments testing a more comprehensive range of tones
span.note: what this limits: the whole set of observations: THESE OBSERVATIONS NEED TO BE CONFIRMED IN ULTRA-HIGH RESOLUTION SCANNING AND SINGLE-UNIT RECORDING EXPERIMENTS TESTING A MORE COMPREHENSIVE RANGE OF TONES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the perceptual measure is a group average collected offline from mostly different people, because the in-scanner task was not designed to yield a sensitive discrimination measure

span.label: THE REGION'S NAME DOES NOT BOUND WHAT IT PROCESSES: robust and frequency-specific responses to sound in CLASSICALLY DEFINED somatosensory areas, against the traditional notion of modality-dedicated cortical systems

span.label: and the question is sharpened before the measurement - multimodal responses are NO LONGER DISPUTED, but whether they convey SPECIFIC representations and how they relate to perception are the open questions

span.label: with the precise gap named: auditory stimulation was already known to evoke distinct signatures in somatosensory cortex, and it REMAINED UNCLEAR whether those patterns represent specific auditory information

span.label: WHICH LOCALIZER DEFINED THE VOXELS IS ITSELF THE HYPOTHESIS TEST: separate auditory, tactile and audio-tactile masks, used to ask whether parietal voxels PRIVILEGED in their sensitivity to sound are the ones that carry the representation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE ANSWER DEPENDS ON THE MASK: fewer and smaller regions show a frequency effect with the tactile mask, and the paper reads that difference as the result rather than as noise
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SAME DATA ARE SIGNIFICANT OR NULL BY MASK, ONCE SPLIT BY HEMISPHERE: in the left somatosensory ROI the auditory mask gives r = 0.24 P < 0.05, the tactile mask r = 0.07 P = 0.25 and the audio-tactile mask r = 0.1 P = 0.15

span.label: and the same split against perception - significant correlations ONLY with the auditory masks, with the tactile left-hemisphere mask at P = 0.07
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE RESULT EXISTS INSIDE A WINDOW OF ANALYSIS SIZE, AND THE WINDOW DIFFERS BY MASK: the auditory mask needs more than 130 voxels, the tactile mask between 50 and 200 - BEYOND WHICH MORE VOXELS WEAKEN IT - and the audio-tactile mask only 300 to 350

span.label: RETRACTED (A SPECULATIVE FRAMEWORK CARRYING THREE MODALS, AS A CAUSAL EDGE) · tactile —causes→ parietal
span.note:
RETRACTED: A SPECULATIVE FRAMEWORK CARRYING THREE MODALS, AS A CAUSAL EDGE. The edge is `tactile --causes--> parietal`. The span: co-occurring signals 'Quotation withheld ... In this framework, the auditory responses in parietal cortex COULD REFLECT predictive coding mechanisms ... Accordingly, parietal regions WOULD ONLY BE responsive to a relatively low range of auditory frequencies'. MAY, COULD, WOULD - and 'IN THIS FRAMEWORK' marks the whole passage as an interpretation the authors are offering, not a result they report. A reader joining on `X --causes--> Y` takes it as a causal relation this paper found. Q-392.
HOW THIS ROW WAS NEARLY MISSED, WHICH IS WORTH RECORDING. Its record id begins `P-rez-Bellido2018` - the diacritic in Perez was stripped to a hyphen - and my display code shortened ids with `id.split('-')[0]`, so the row printed as `P[37]` and I could not identify it. I declined to retract it rather than guess, and came back for it. A TRUNCATED DISPLAY KEY CAN MAKE A ROW UNFINDABLE WITHOUT MAKING IT LOOK WRONG - the same fault as a prefix used for lookup, one step further out, in the part of the pipeline nobody tests. — strength of the relation: 0.9 — the proposed route is an extensive history of CO-ACTIVATION, with the falsifiable consequence that parietal regions should respond only to the low band shared with touch

span.note: RETRACTED: THE WRONG PAIR, AND THE PAPER SAYS THE QUESTION IS OPEN. The edge is `feedforward --distinct-from--> fMRI`. The span: 'Quotation withheld' The two things being distinguished are FEEDFORWARD and FEEDBACK; fMRI is the INSTRUMENT WHOSE LIMITATION PREVENTS DECIDING BETWEEN THEM. The edge keeps one side and the instrument - the same shape as Lim2007[21] and Halgren2006[19], where an endpoint was the dimension rather than a side. And `it is unclear whether` says the distinction is not established here at all. Q-430. — strength of the relation: 1 — the limited temporal resolution of fMRI cannot separate feedforward from feedback signaling

span.label: Auditory frequency information is therefore distributed across brain regions traditionally treated as dedicated to touch, not confined to auditory cortex.
